name: Sunray Grandby 3-Person Outdoor Infrared Sauna 300D3
description: Description The SunRay Grandby 3-Person Outdoor Infrared Sauna is built with a sealed weatherproof cabin and metal composite roof, making it suitable for year-round outdoor use. Crafted from durable Canadian hemlock, it features 7 ceramic heaters that deliver even heat up to 140°F. The spacious interior includes wide bench seating, recessed lighting, and Bluetooth speakers. Additional features include an ozone sterilization system for purified air, LED control panel, cup holders, and more. Easy to assemble, the Grandby is designed to bring relaxation and wellness to your backyard.
